BERWYN, Pennsylvania: A new mosque recently opened in this . . . suburb of Philadelphia. . . .  

[The] leaders . . . did not seek publicity for the happy occasion, only continued peace with their neighbors: a Jewish synagogue next door and Baptist church across the street.

—Kathy Matheson, Associated Press, September 10, 2010

This event best demonstrates which feature of the American way of life?

options.label: F
options.text: The First Amendment guarantees personal freedoms.

options.label: G
options.text: The Declaration of Independence asserts the principle of popular sovereignty.

options.label: H
options.text: The U.S. Constitution establishes the structure of the federal government.

options.label: J
options.text: The Fifth Amendment protects the rights of the accused.
